definitions.explanation: Property, money, or assets left behind by a deceased person to be distributed to heirs.
Something of cultural, historical, or intellectual value passed down from previous generations.

examples.japanese: {遺産|いさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺産|いさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けた→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。

examples.japanese: ⟦{先人|せんじん}→先人：23803_senjin⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{知的|ちてき}→知的：13700_chiteki⟧{遺産|いさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧いくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to pass on the intellectual legacy left by our predecessors to the next generation.

notes:
{遺産|いさん} covers both the legal concept of inheritance and the broader concept of cultural heritage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺産|いさん}⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧ (inheritance)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{遺産|いさん} (World Heritage)
- ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧{遺産|いさん} (cultural heritage)
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧{遺産|いさん} (natural heritage)
- {負|ふ}の{遺産|いさん} (negative legacy)

The compound ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧{遺産|いさん} (World Heritage) is extremely common in Japanese media and travel contexts. Japan has numerous UNESCO World Heritage sites. {負|ふ}の{遺産|いさん} (negative legacy) is used to describe harmful things inherited from the past, such as environmental damage or debt.
